game.name: Prince of Persia 2
game.desc:
The Shadow and the Flame, the 1993 Macintosh version, running natively (an unofficial port: the original program translated to C). Needs the disk image of your own copy, in ports/pop2.
D-pad or stick move, A action, B second button, Start pause, Select time left. Hotkey + B: extras menu (save states with pictures, levels, cheats, statistics). Hotkey + Y save state, + X load, + Left rewind, + Up health, + Right time, + Start quit.
